properties.description: A Requirement can be designated `published`, and `export_surface` then carries it alongside the boundaries — so a design can state what it UNDERTAKES TO DO, not only what it exposes. Opt-in per requirement, `internal` by default because publishing is a commitment; undesignated intent is still withheld and still counted. A surface with no promises says so in as many words, so "none stated" never reads as "none exist".
properties.name: Publish a promise, not just a boundary
